headline: YMVTHEDAD LOST BY 2.47 WITH A 7.00 RECEIVER ON THE BENCH. TUB89 CUT A KICKER WHO SCORED 17.00 FOR THE OTHER GUY 🪑🦵🤡

sections.heading: THE 2.47-POINT BENCH TAX 🪑💸
sections.body:
YMVtheDAD walked in with the league's best points-for (1,296.46, nobody's even close) and walked out with a loss to Evz132, 130.17 to 127.70. The margin was 2.47. Luther Burden III started at wide receiver and caught 2.30 points. Germie Bernard sat on the bench with 7.00. That's a 4.70-point swap that wins the game. LOL. 😭

And the winner wasn't exactly a genius either: Evz132 started Jonathan Taylor (4.70) and benched Jacory Croskey-Merritt (14.70). The league bookie left ten points in the drawer and still cashed the ticket. The house always wins, even when the house can't set a lineup. 🎰

sections.heading: THE KICKER YOU CUT 🦵🔄
sections.body:
Tub89 dropped Tyler Bass to make room for Dallas Goedert. imbackbeech scooped Bass off waivers for a cool $0, started him, and Bass kicked his way to 17.00. Goedert's day for Tub89: 4.30. LOL.

imbackbeech won by 7.06. Do the math on who won that game. Tub89 didn't feel it because Tub89 beat ChunckyM by 44.65 anyway, but somewhere a free kicker is sending Tub89 a thank-you card. 💌

sections.heading: WEEK'S MASSACRE: TUB89 126.26, CHUNCKYM 81.61 🔪
sections.body:
C.J. Stroud (26.46), CeeDee Lamb (24.70) and Emmett Johnson (22.30) did the bulk of it, and the Ravens defense threw in 13.50. Tub89 is now 8-3 and sitting second.

ChunckyM's side of it is a crime scene. Jonah Coleman went for 32.90 at flex, the best game anybody got out of a non-QB all week, and it was wasted. Josh Allen managed 14.16. And ChunckyM spent the week's waiver run picking up the Chargers defense (dropping the Dolphins to do it), and the Chargers posted -2.95. Negative. They paid nothing and still got robbed. 🧾

sections.heading: WAIVER WIRE HEROES AND VILLAINS 🛒
sections.body:
Hvang94 grabbed Justin Herbert off free agency, started him on the spot, and got 26.44. That's the first-place team, by the way, now 9-2, and it is still shopping in the bargain bin and winning. 🛍️

cvang1990 paid $3 for the 49ers defense and got 16.00, which is a great return on a bad week. Keeneng snagged Joey Slye (13.00) and the Eagles defense (9.65) and both showed up. Unfortunately Keeneng's actual offense did not. More on that below. 👇

sections.heading: THE FULL FOURTEEN: EVERYBODY GETS A TURN 🎤
sections.body:
1. Evz132 — 130.17, won by 2.47. The week's high score, in a low-scoring week, powered by Cam Ward (26.22), Ashton Jeanty (25.40) and a vintage 22.40 from Travis Kelce. The bookie gets the trophy, but benching Croskey-Merritt's 14.70 for Jonathan Taylor's 4.70 turned a 12.47-point cushion into a 2.47-point sweat. 🎰

2. YMVtheDAD — 127.70, LOST by 2.47. Second-best score in the league, Jahmyr Gibbs 25.80, Joe Burrow 23.90, and it's a loss. Germie Bernard's 7.00 on the bench over Luther Burden's 2.30 is the whole story. Most points in the league all year and the schedule still finds a way. 🪑

3. Tub89 — 126.26, won by 44.65. The week's biggest blowout behind Stroud's 26.46 and Lamb's 24.70. Still, cutting Tyler Bass so he could kick 17.00 for imbackbeech is the kind of thing that comes back in December. 🦵

4. muahuavang — 113.94, won by 16.56. The Bears defense dropped 20.20, which is more than any running back on this roster. Meanwhile Bryce Young (19.96) and David Montgomery (13.90) sat on the bench outscoring the guys who started, Caleb Williams (18.34) and Rico Dowdle (5.40). A win is a win at 3-8. 🐻

5. mouavang86 — 106.21, won by 29.79. Patrick Mahomes threw up 30.96 and Chris Boswell kicked 13.00. Kyle Monangai's 1.80 started while Samaje Perine (11.70) and Braelon Allen (8.90) watched, so the margin could've been a lot uglier. 🏈

6. jayvang100 — 102.25, won by 19.76. Two straight weeks of guessing the QB wrong, and this week the coin finally landed: Dak Prescott started and went for 43.90, the week's best game. Purdy sat with 28.20, and for once the QB on the bench scored less. 🪙✅

7. cvang1990 — 97.38, LOST by 16.56. Chuba Hubbard 26.00, the $3 49ers defense 16.00, Cam Little 13.00, all good. Rachaad White started and posted a clean 0.00, which is a hole you can't dig out of. 🕳️

8. imbackbeech — 97.11, won by 7.06. Tyler Bass for $0 scored 17.00 and that's the game. Ladd McConkey's 18.20 sat on the bench behind Adonai Mitchell's 4.00, and Ja'Marr Chase gave you 5.60, so the free kicker had to save the day. 🆓

9. Hvang94 — 92.69, won by 14.93. Ninth in points, first in the standings, 9-2. Free-agent Justin Herbert dropped 26.44 the week he arrived, because of course he did. The luckiest manager in the league keeps on finding money in his couch cushions. 🍀

10. KevinVang — 90.05, LOST by 7.06. Kirk Cousins gave you 7.40 points at quarterback and a quarterback who cracks 15 wins this game. The Texans defense (16.95) and DJ Moore (19.10) tried their best. 🧓

11. Keeneng — 82.49, LOST by 19.76. Three starters, J.K. Dobbins, Courtland Sutton and Juwan Johnson, combined for 0.00. Joey Slye (13.00) and the Eagles defense (9.65) were both good pickups, but there's no waiver claim that fixes three empty starters. 🫥🫥🫥

12. ChunckyM — 81.61, LOST by 44.65. Jonah Coleman went for 32.90 and it didn't matter because the Chargers defense you just picked up scored -2.95 and Michael Mayer added 0.90. Josh Allen's 14.16 didn't help. Biggest loss of the week, and you went shopping for it. 🛒📉

13. VangMushu — 77.76, LOST by 14.93. The Vikings defense went -1.90 and Emeka Egbuka gave you 2.80 while Xavier Worthy's 10.80 sat on the bench. Bucky Irving (17.50) and Jayden Daniels (17.06) deserved better company. 📉

14. Tonglue — 76.42, LOST by 29.79. Spencer Shrader kicked exactly 1.00 point, and Jakobi Meyers sat on the bench with 10.50 while Garrett Wilson started for 5.40. The Broncos defense (15.60) nearly outscored McCarthy (16.22) and James Cook (16.20). Basement view's lovely this time of year. 🏚️

sections.heading: THE STANDINGS: SIX SEATS, NINE CHAIRS 🪑🪑🪑
sections.body:
Hvang94 sits alone at 9-2, Tub89 is 8-3, and YMVtheDAD and ChunckyM are both 7-4 after losing this week. Then comes a five-way pileup at 6-5: jayvang100, cvang1990, mouavang86, Evz132 and KevinVang, separated by nothing but points-for.

Six teams make the playoffs and there are three regular-season weeks left. If the top four hold, five teams are fighting for two spots, so three of you are are getting the bad news in December. Start your best receiver. Looking at you, YMVtheDAD. LOL. 👀
